expiry_behavior: expired or unapproved entries block tools/release_gate.py (verdict NO_GO)

entries.rationale: pk_core conformance harness absent from candidate; cannot pin or run
entries.compensating: standalone runtime + v43 suites run in normal and -O
entries.remediation: supply pk_core with version+digest; pin in requirements.lock

entries.rationale: integration tier uses contract-faithful adapters, not real INV-57/59/70/71 binaries (not in archive)
entries.compensating: adapters implement the PK_AGENT_PEER/1 contract incl. faults; tests assert contract shapes

entries.rationale: stdlib-only build ships HMAC signatures; asymmetric (Sigstore/Ed25519) needs an approved crypto dependency
entries.compensating: digest pinning + HMAC trust root + pinned policy digest + generated code forced to heavy tier
entries.remediation: approve crypto lib in APPROVED_TECH.json; implement Signer

entries.rationale: hash chains are process-local; external append-only anchor not available
entries.compensating: heads exported in backup bundles and status; config require_remote_anchor defaults true (capability flag)
entries.remediation: anchor heads to an external signed log

entries.rationale: power/thermal needs a physical constrained edge node; none available. far_edge profile is optional
entries.compensating: CPU-time per step measured as proxy; far_edge profile tightens budgets
entries.remediation: measure on reference far-edge hardware or keep far_edge unsupported

entries.rationale: only CPython 3.11.15 / Linux x86_64 executed; CI matrix declared but not run
entries.compensating: stdlib-only, no native code, no endianness-sensitive encoding

deprecated_behaviors.behavior: Agent.step result 'reason' as sole failure signal
